system.description:
The mage commands, bargains with, or binds a spirit to a task, place, or object. Rank 2 contacts and affects spirits; rank 4 binds and compels them into service. The spirit may resist with a contested roll, and mistreated spirits often seek revenge once freed.

Dice Pool: Manipulation + Occult (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Spirit 4; mechanics paraphrased.
